status: experimental-only; not approved for production; holdout false-continue rate remains high

stateFields.utterance: All held fragments plus latest final transcript, joined by newline.
stateFields.preceding_assistant: Last 80 characters of preceding assistant reply, or null.
stateFields.preceding_user: Last 80 characters of preceding user utterance, or null.
stateFields.queued_inputs: At most three queued user excerpts, at most 80 characters each.

question: Which description best matches the user utterance? It may contain several fragments of the SAME sentence joined by newlines. Use a question_to_user to interpret short answers. A stop request requires an assistant that is busy. Meaningful unfinished words are speech, not noise.

criteria.stop_request: The user explicitly commands the currently busy assistant to stop now, correct its ongoing work, or immediately switch tasks.
criteria.non_speech: The input is only an ASR noise/silence marker or a standalone hesitation sound with no question to answer.
criteria.complete_utterance: The user has finished expressing a request, question, fact, or answer. The meaning is complete in context, even with very few words.
criteria.unfinished_utterance: The user has started meaningful speech but has not finished the sentence or thought. A required object, value or following clause is still absent.

nativeFormat: Preserve D3 system template, State / Question / Options and A/B/C/D answer-code readout; do not ask for generated JSON or explanation.
